description: Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos + The Frozen Throne v1.26a (via Proton)
long: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne is the expansion to Reign of Chaos, a real-time strategy game combining base building and army management with RPG-style hero units that gain levels and abilities. It continues the campaign across four playable factions and adds new units and a neutral hero roster. It was developed and published by Blizzard Entertainment and supports online and LAN multiplayer.
